dse_runs.notes: Spec high_precision: strict accuracy (max_abs_err <= 2^-20) at >= 50 MSPS. Selection rule is min luts_plus_ffs, so favor designs near the accuracy/throughput feasibility boundary with small area. Explore iterative (few stages, high precision) and unrolled_k families; pipelined likely too large for area objective.

selected_facts.dds_provenance: simulated (hw_dse.l2.dds l2-v1: golden-model DDS, 32-bit phase accumulator, coherent 16384-point FFT, tone bin 1297)

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **high_precision** was taken down the full fidelity ladder and finalized: L1 used all 400 evaluations via the structured DSE graph, which found exactly one feasible, non-dominated design — `pipelined_m: data_width=24, n_iter=23, angle_guard=2, frac_guard=2, rounding=round, m=7` (luts_plus_ffs=2393, power_index=4.5, throughput 54.3 MSPS, max_abs_err 7.74e-07 ≈ 2^-20.30, all estimates except the exact error). L2 system simulation confirmed the selection (contract latency 6 cycles, one input/cycle; DDS SFDR 147.6 dBc, SNR 132.4 dB, simulated). L3/L4 had no recorded verification or synthesis rows for this W=24 design (fresh runs too heavy for a live campaign), so L5 back_annotate returned no_measured_data with no winner change — no reexplore was needed. The spec was finalized on that selection, and the lesson (tight 2^-20/50 MSPS box leaves only pipelined_m feasible) was noted, though memory is switched off for this run.
